verdict.rationale: Viam explicitly offers cloud-managed fleet monitoring/alerting, remote monitoring, access control, and OTA updates, plus a fleet management API to manage organizations, locations, and machines, and configuration to connect and monitor machines 'from anywhere.' This covers health (GetMachineStatus, alerting), status, and centralized dashboard-style fleet management across locations. Missing for 10: explicit mention of a unified 'location' map/view or independent hands-on confirmation of the dashboard UI beyond vendor docs.
